info.title: Kortspil API
info.description: API foundation for Kortspil identity, lobby, and multiplayer games.

get.summary: Check whether the API process is responsive.
Resolve the current App Service Authentication identity.
List open waiting tables and the current player’s tables.

post.summary: Create a waiting table as an authenticated host.
Request a human seat. Private tables require an invitation token.

get.summary: List pending seat requests in VIP-first order for the host.

put.summary: Accept or decline a pending seat request as the table host.

post.summary: Create a 24-hour invitation for a private waiting table.

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation as the owner of its table.

post.summary: Start a waiting table after all configured human seats are occupied.

get.summary: Resume an active game with the requesting player’s private snapshot.

post.summary: Preview legal Kasino moves for the current player.
Submit a server-validated Es Makker game action.
Request membership on the centrally managed VIP list.

get.summary: List pending VIP requests for the configured VIP administrator.

put.summary: Approve or deny a VIP request.

get.summary: List current VIP members for the configured VIP administrator.

delete.summary: Remove a user from the VIP list and record the administrative action.
